goal: Rebuild the current app page layouts so they visually match the extracted Stitch Source BlendR Stage 4 prototype while preserving current routes, backend behavior, API contracts, workspace scoping, forms, mutations, and component responsibility mapping.

allowed_changes_after_approval: Approved visual-only prototype features mapped to current behavior
disallowed_changes_without_new_approval: New production routes or route aliases
execution_policy.dependency_graph_rule: Execute tickets only after all depends_on_tickets are complete. Parallel execution is allowed only within the same batch when ticket dependencies do not overlap.

source_of_truth_policy.rule: Stitch controls visual structure and layout. The current app controls data, routes, auth, APIs, mutations, persistence, and validation behavior.

approved_scope_from_revision_summary: User/workspace profile block with avatar/persona as visual-only shell footer
Last sync text derived from available import timestamps
Import workspace operational status header backed by current job/worker state only
Website wizard processing states mapped to real queued/running/completed job states
Website selected categories summary using existing category API behavior
PDF success View Job Results handoff mapped to real import job detail route
Import job event/log details rendered from real ImportJobEvent records
Discovery candidate edit/resolve fields mapped to current candidate update behavior
Discovery toast notification as local client feedback only
Catalog pagination controls using local/client pagination or existing query behavior
Catalog row quick action icon implemented as accessible existing item link/action
AI provider credential error Fix credentials affordance mapped to current edit/upsert form behavior
AI provider Edit buttons mapped to current provider update behavior
AI capability routing table mapped to current save-routing API
deferred_scope_excluded: Discovery filter pills requiring unavailable candidate states such as conflicts or duplicates
New Catalog Item category/taxonomy field requiring schema or state decisions
Vendor footer links for Privacy Policy, Operations Log, or System Status
discarded_scope_excluded: PDF demo state buttons for Empty/File Selected/Loading/Error/Success

tickets.title: Establish Stitch rebuild baseline and visual QA contract
implementation_scope: Record screenshot dimensions, route list, source screenshots, and pass/fail criteria before page rebuild work starts.
Confirm every route keeps its current behavior owner and API dependencies.
Confirm deferred/discarded prototype features remain excluded.
acceptance_criteria: A route/component/source screenshot matrix exists for every page in scope.
The visual QA contract defines desktop, tablet, and mobile screenshot targets.
No application source code changes are made by this foundation ticket.
The approval/defer/discard scope from the revision summary is copied into implementation evidence.
validation_steps: Validate that all ticket route_refs have at least one current app file or explicit inherited-source note.
Validate that no deferred or discarded item appears in a downstream acceptance criterion as production scope.

tickets.title: Rebuild shared shell, sidebar, topbar, and design-system primitives from Stitch
implementation_scope: Translate Stitch color, spacing, type, border, badge, card, table, form, drawer, and button language into app-owned CSS/classes.
Rebuild the persistent left sidebar and mobile header to match Stitch proportions and active-route behavior.
Add approved visual-only user/workspace profile block in the shell footer without adding user settings routes.
acceptance_criteria: Shell visual structure matches Stitch sidebar/topbar/canvas layout across in-scope app routes.
Navigation uses existing route paths only.
Topbar notification/help controls are excluded unless already backed by current approved behavior.
No Tailwind CDN, inline prototype JavaScript, href="#" links, or hard-coded demo IDs are introduced.
Existing auth/workspace scoping behavior remains unchanged.
validation_steps: Run typecheck/build checks used by the web app.
Run a static search for Tailwind CDN references, showState controls, href="#", and known prototype demo IDs.
Capture shell screenshots on /app, /app/imports, /app/catalog, /app/vendors, and /app/settings/ai.

tickets.title: Rebuild workspace overview route from Stitch overview prototype
implementation_scope: Rebuild the /app dashboard layout using Stitch overview regions: breadcrumb/header, quick actions, active jobs, catalog health, provider/status summary, and discovery/import panels.
Use real workspace counts, import jobs, catalog counts, provider checks, and links.
Keep approved permission/provider summary cards only where they map to current auth/provider data.
acceptance_criteria: /app visually matches the Stitch overview layout at desktop width.
Sparse local data still renders the same structural slots through real empty states or placeholders clearly tied to real state.
All quick actions preserve current app routes and existing behavior.
No new /app/overview route is created.
validation_steps: Capture /app screenshot and compare against workspace_overview_source_blendr/screen.png.
Verify links route to existing pages.
Run page-level smoke test with current local database state.

tickets.title: Rebuild imports workspace and import jobs list from Stitch imports prototype
implementation_scope: Rebuild method chooser cards, operational status header, recent jobs table, status badges, and last sync text.
Derive last sync from available latest import job timestamps.
Render job cards/details only from current import job data.
acceptance_criteria: /app/imports visually matches the Stitch imports workspace layout.
/app/imports/jobs inherits the same table/card visual grammar without creating a new prototype-only route.
Website import, PDF import, and job detail links preserve current route behavior.
No fake job IDs or unbacked operational statuses are introduced.
validation_steps: Capture /app/imports and /app/imports/jobs screenshots.
Verify job list renders correctly with zero jobs and at least one real local job.
Run import route smoke tests.

tickets.title: Rebuild website import wizard from Stitch wizard prototype
implementation_scope: Rebuild source setup, detected category tree, selected categories summary, and processing/success handoff visuals.
Map processing states to current queued/running/completed job states instead of simulated prototype steps.
Use the existing category selector/API behavior for detected categories and selected category summaries.
acceptance_criteria: /app/imports/website visually matches the Stitch website import wizard layout.
Detected Category Tree is included only through current category data/API behavior.
Download Analysis Report PDF remains excluded.
Submitting a website import still uses the current form/action/API flow.
validation_steps: Capture website wizard screenshots before submit and after a real queued job handoff when possible.
Verify form submission still creates or queues a real import job.
Verify category selection behavior is unchanged.

tickets.title: Rebuild PDF import route from Stitch PDF prototype
implementation_scope: Rebuild upload drop zone, OCR/AI context, real pending/error/success states, and job-result handoff visuals.
Use only current PDF upload behavior and current import job route handoff.
Discard all prototype demo state buttons.
acceptance_criteria: /app/imports/pdf visually matches the Stitch PDF import layout.
PDF success View Job Results maps to the real import job detail route when a job ID exists.
Prototype Empty/File Selected/Loading/Error/Success demo buttons do not ship.
Current PDF upload API contract remains unchanged.
validation_steps: Capture PDF import screenshots for empty and local selected/pending/error states where feasible.
Run PDF upload smoke path using the existing local workflow.
Static-search for removed demo state controls.

tickets.title: Rebuild import job detail route from Stitch job detail prototype
implementation_scope: Rebuild job status, progress/timeline, source metadata, retry/cancel actions, discovery handoff, and events/logs regions.
Render event/log details from real ImportJobEvent records.
Preserve current retry, cancel, category, and discovery-session action behavior.
acceptance_criteria: /app/imports/jobs/:jobId visually matches the Stitch import job detail layout.
Import job event/log details are shown only from real job events.
Notification/help topbar icons remain excluded.
Current job action APIs and error handling remain unchanged.
validation_steps: Capture job detail screenshot for a real local job.
Verify retry/cancel/category/discovery controls still call existing actions/APIs.
Run import job detail route smoke test.

tickets.title: Rebuild discovery routes from Stitch discovery prototype
implementation_scope: Rebuild candidate table, bulk action toolbar, preview drawer, edit/resolve form, AI inference details, and local toast feedback.
Map filter controls only to current candidate states.
Use current candidate PATCH/resolve behavior and current candidate/source payload fields.
acceptance_criteria: /app/discovery/:sessionId visually matches the Stitch discovery workspace layout.
/app/discovery inherits the same visual grammar for the session list.
Candidate edit/resolve fields and AI inference details remain backed by current data/action APIs.
All/New/Conflicts/Duplicates pills are excluded unless they map cleanly to current candidate state without backend changes.
Toast behavior remains local client feedback, not a new global notification system.
validation_steps: Capture /app/discovery and /app/discovery/:sessionId screenshots.
Verify candidate preview/edit/resolve flows against existing APIs.
Verify no unbacked conflict/duplicate state is introduced.

tickets.title: Rebuild catalog list and detail routes from Stitch catalog prototype
implementation_scope: Rebuild search toolbar, current type/status/category-compatible filters, table rows, row navigation, pagination controls, loading/empty/error states, and detail visual grammar.
Implement pagination as local/client state or existing query behavior only.
Implement row quick action icon as an accessible current item link/action.
acceptance_criteria: /app/catalog visually matches the Stitch catalog layout.
/app/catalog/:itemId inherits the Stitch catalog/form detail language.
Catalog category filter uses current backed fields only.
Catalog mobile floating create button remains excluded.
Catalog demo state toggles do not ship.
validation_steps: Capture catalog list and catalog detail screenshots.
Verify search/filter/pagination behavior with current local data.
Verify row quick action is keyboard-accessible and routes to the existing item route.

tickets.title: Rebuild new catalog item form from Stitch catalog form prototype
implementation_scope: Rebuild segmented product/service control, grouped form sections, validation layout, and save/cancel action bar around current CatalogItemForm behavior.
Map product/service selection to current item type model.
Exclude category/taxonomy field changes that require schema or state decisions.
acceptance_criteria: /app/catalog/new visually matches the Stitch new catalog item layout.
Create flow still uses current catalog item API contract.
Field-level validation and error rendering remain intact.
No new taxonomy/schema-backed category field is added.
validation_steps: Capture new catalog item form screenshot.
Submit a valid and invalid form through current local behavior.
Verify generated payload shape is unchanged.

tickets.title: Rebuild vendors list, detail, and create routes from Stitch vendors prototype
implementation_scope: Rebuild vendor table, real loading/empty/error states, new vendor CTA, row navigation, detail layout, and create form visual grammar.
Preserve current vendor routes and API contracts.
Do not add request-access, footer links, or demo state switchers.
acceptance_criteria: /app/vendors visually matches the Stitch vendors layout.
/app/vendors/new and /app/vendors/:vendorId inherit the Stitch vendors/form visual language.
Vendor denied/request-access state remains deferred.
Vendor footer links remain excluded.
Vendor state switcher does not ship.
validation_steps: Capture vendor list, vendor detail, and vendor create screenshots.
Verify vendor create/detail flows preserve current behavior.
Static-search for excluded footer routes and demo switcher behavior.

tickets.title: Rebuild settings hub and AI provider settings from Stitch AI prototype
implementation_scope: Rebuild provider cards/list, provider health states, credential error affordance, Edit buttons, capability routing table, save routing action, and health check action.
Map Fix credentials and Edit to current provider form/edit/upsert behavior.
Keep /app/settings as an existing settings hub or AI-settings entry point without adding docs/support routes.
acceptance_criteria: /app/settings/ai visually matches the Stitch AI provider settings layout.
AI capability routing table saves through the current routing API.
Fix credentials and Edit controls are backed by existing form/update behavior.
Documentation/support footer links remain excluded.
Provider health and manual fallback behavior remain unchanged.
validation_steps: Capture /app/settings and /app/settings/ai screenshots.
Verify provider add/edit/health/routing flows with current APIs.
Verify no unbacked docs/support links are introduced.

tickets.title: Run integrated visual consistency pass across rebuilt routes
implementation_scope: Capture rebuilt app screenshots at desktop, tablet, and mobile breakpoints.
Compare each route against its Stitch prototype screen or inherited visual source.
Create follow-up defects for remaining visual mismatches instead of expanding scope silently.
acceptance_criteria: Each in-scope route has screenshot evidence.
Each route has an explicit pass, accepted deviation, or defect reference.
No deferred/discarded feature is accidentally visible as a production control.
Responsive behavior preserves the Stitch visual system and current navigation.
validation_steps: Open each in-scope route locally.
Capture screenshots for configured breakpoints.
Review screenshots against prototype source images and record deviations.

tickets.title: Run final regression gate for rebuilt visual layer
implementation_scope: Run final static, type, build, route, and workflow smoke checks after visual rebuild.
Confirm scraper, PDF OCR, import job, discovery, catalog, vendor, and AI settings behavior was not interrupted.
Record known visual deviations and unresolved defects before marking execution complete.
acceptance_criteria: Type/build checks pass or have explicit approved exception records.
Key app routes return successfully in local runtime.
Existing backend/API contracts remain unchanged unless separately approved.
Visual QA evidence exists and references the Stitch prototype screenshots.
Execution is not marked complete with unresolved critical visual or behavioral defects.
validation_steps: Run the web app's available lint/type/build/test commands.
Smoke test scraper/import, PDF import, import job detail, discovery candidate action, catalog create/list, vendor create/list, and AI provider settings paths.
Record final gate result with links to evidence.

batches.title: Shared shell and design system rebuild
Top-level route rebuilds
batches.parallelization_note: These tickets may run in parallel after the shell rebuild if shared component edits are coordinated or serialized through separate files.

batches.title: Workflow, detail, and form route rebuilds
batches.parallelization_note: Workflow/detail tickets may run in parallel only when their parent route visual grammar is complete and they do not edit the same form component concurrently.

dependency_notes: TICKET-060 must run first because it defines the visual QA contract and route/component baseline.
TICKET-061 must run before page rebuilds because every target page depends on the shared shell and visual primitives.
TICKET-064, TICKET-065, and TICKET-066 depend on imports visual grammar from TICKET-063.
TICKET-069 depends on catalog visual grammar from TICKET-068.
TICKET-072 must wait for all rebuild tickets to complete because it validates cross-route visual consistency.
TICKET-073 must run last because it is the regression and release-readiness gate for this repair layer.
